exposure: Gestational age at membrane rupture (PPROM group: 28(+0)-31(+6) weeks vs. 32(+0)-36(+6) weeks)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 714 women who presented with third-trimester PPROM or PROM
finding: PPROM was associated with a significantly lower gestational age, higher C-reactive protein levels and body temperature on admission, longer latency period, and a higher rate of NICU admission compared to PROM.
mod_finding: Breech presentation and history of previous cesarean section were associated with occurrence of PPROM compared with PROM.
